# Evercraft Opportunity Fabric

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: opportunity-fabric
Class: protected_collaboration_partner_matching_and_execution_orchestration
Canonical URL: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/registry/opportunity-fabric
Authority: public capability discovery plus verified private metadata-first planning, non-binding sourcing, transparent sourcing comparison, and multi-party assembly; no public protected-file delivery, payment, or final legal-agreement authority is claimed
Human confirmation required: yes
Runtime or CHUM llms.txt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/opportunity-fabric/llms.txt

## Natural-language intents
- I have designs and need a printer or manufacturing partner
- find a production partner for my artwork
- I have songs or demos and need a producer or recording studio
- find collaborators near me who can help finish this project
- I have equipment or unused capacity and want complementary work
- I need a subcontractor or specialist so I can execute this job
- I have intellectual property but do not want to give it away while looking for partners
- help me turn this unfinished idea or asset into an executable team
- find licensing production distribution or collaboration opportunities for work I already made
- assemble several accepted partners into one execution team
- break this project into work packages for different partners
- coordinate a designer printer fulfillment partner and retailer on one project
- build a music team with a producer studio engineer and videographer
- figure out which partners I need for this opportunity
- turn this project into work packages and find matching partners
- suggest the team for this project
- ask a matched partner if they have capacity for this package
- get availability and a quote from accepted partners before assembling a team
- shortlist supplier quotes into a temporary execution team
- turn shortlisted quotes into team invitations and work-package offers
- compare quotes for the same work package without automatically choosing a vendor
- explain the tradeoff between price lead time capacity geography and observed execution history
- show me which sourcing evidence is self-reported versus observed

## Boundaries
- public matching must not require protected creative files or confidential material
- uploading listing viewing matching or forming a team does not transfer ownership or grant commercial rights
- protected disclosure remains gated and actual protected-file delivery is not exposed as a public production workflow
- Creator Covenant legal language remains draft_for_counsel_review
- public Base44 deployment URL is not yet claimed
- fingerprint vault evidence support is not copyright registration patent filing or dispositive proof of ownership
- multi-party team creation requires already-accepted source relationships
- each counterparty must accept the specific team invitation before receiving a work package
- work-package acceptance does not grant intellectual-property rights or disclose protected material
- actual protected-file delivery remains disabled
- execution blueprints use safe opportunity metadata and public member capability metadata only
- execution blueprints return no private contact information or protected content
- execution blueprint recommendations are not membership qualification proof agreement authority or license
- unmatched capabilities remain explicit gaps rather than invented partners
- suggested candidates still require the protected connection handshake
- sourcing requests require an already-accepted protected connection
- sourcing availability and quote responses create no payment obligation or work acceptance
- shortlisting a sourcing response creates no team membership or contract
- only shortlisted Available or Limited responses from one project and one blueprint can seed sourced team invitations
- accepting a sourced team invitation materializes the package as Offered and Not accepted
- sourcing comparison uses explicit fixed weights and preserves evidence classes
- quote availability and lead time are participant-supplied rather than independently observed
- Fabric history uses accepted Opportunity Fabric work-package records only and missing history is neutral
- prices are compared only against same-currency peers; no FX normalization is claimed
- comparison ordering requires human decision and creates no partner selection shortlist membership contract rights work acceptance or payment

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
